detail.nothing.say: The reading found nothing to report.

detail.key-id.say: The discipline's prefix and the finding's place in the priority order.

detail.key-headline.say: The finding in one sentence, with the detail beneath it.

detail.key-severity.say: Critical to Info on the coloured tag, and Positive for a control found working.

detail.key-todo.say: The fix, on the orange bar.

detail.key-lede.say: Each finding below is laid out this way.

detail.scanner-intro.say: Each card is a package or rule the scanners flagged, most severe first, naming any finding above that rests on it.

detail.intro.say: We read <whole> against <count> disciplines and found <weaknesses> <findings>, along with <good> <controls> working as intended. Each discipline has a section of its own, including one that found nothing, so a reader can see it was read. Within a section, findings run in priority order, and each names the model that found it, the file and lines it rests on, whether a second check confirmed it, and the fix. We read the code without running it and changed nothing.

detail.legend-priority.say: P0 do first · P1 near-term · P2 should-fix · P3 cleanup.

detail.legend-result.say: Scanned where a scanner found it · verified where a second check confirmed it against the <source> · asserted where nothing did.

detail.no-browser.say: There's no browser here to print with. The page is at <page>, so open it and print to PDF.
